meta.text_status_note: GO is distributed as OBO and OWL, not as prose. Each provision below is a PROSE RENDERING of is_a and part_of edges drawn from a small fragment of the ontology, written so that the entity-relation extractor has surface forms to match. Definitions are paraphrased, not quoted. This fixture demonstrates the extractor pair; it is not a substitute for reading the ontology, and no result about GO should be reported from it.
meta.purpose: The mirror image of the FRCP control (paper §11.1). Over this corpus the entity-relation extractor yields claims and the norm-tuple extractor yields almost nothing, because a reference ontology asserts what kinds there are and issues no directives. Neither extractor is better than the other; each is built for a different kind of structure, and running both over both corpora is what makes the mismatch visible rather than a matter of assertion.
meta.paper_reference: Cell 1 of the registered design (paper §10.1 Table 11): no chain, Stratum D predicted to produce no findings.

provisions.heading: biological_process
provisions.text: A biological process is a kind of occurrent. A biological process consists of one or more organised assemblies of molecular functions. A biological process is not a subclass of molecular function and is not a subclass of cellular component.

provisions.heading: molecular_function
provisions.text: A molecular function is a kind of activity carried out by a gene product at the molecular level. A molecular function is realized in a biological process. A molecular function depends on the gene product that bears it.

provisions.heading: cellular_component
provisions.text: A cellular component is a kind of material entity. A cellular component is part of a cell or is located in the extracellular environment. A cell is composed of cellular components.

provisions.heading: programmed cell death
provisions.text: Programmed cell death is a kind of cell death. Cell death is a kind of cellular process. A cellular process is a kind of biological process.

provisions.heading: apoptotic process
provisions.text: An apoptotic process is a kind of programmed cell death. An apoptotic process is part of a broader tissue remodelling process in a multicellular organism. An apoptotic process depends on the cell that undergoes it.

provisions.heading: kinase activity
provisions.text: Kinase activity is a kind of transferase activity. Transferase activity is a kind of catalytic activity. Catalytic activity is a kind of molecular function. Kinase activity is borne by a gene product.

provisions.heading: nucleus
provisions.text: A nucleus is a kind of membrane-bounded organelle. A membrane-bounded organelle is a kind of organelle. An organelle is a kind of cellular component. A nucleus is part of a cell.

provisions.heading: DNA repair
provisions.text: DNA repair is a kind of cellular response to DNA damage stimulus. DNA repair is part of a DNA metabolic process. A DNA metabolic process is a kind of cellular process.
